title: Phone Screen-Time Trend and Goal
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=screentime:usage
| timechart span=1d sum(minutes) as screen_min
| eval hours=round(screen_min/60,1), goal_h=3, over_goal=if(hours>goal_h,1,0)
description: Trends your daily phone screen time against a personal goal, making a creeping habit visible before it eats your evenings.
value: Screen-time awareness is the first step to changing it; a trend against a goal is far more motivating than a weekly guilt notification.
implementation: Export screen-time data to HEC; schedule daily and nudge yourself on days you exceed your goal.
visualization: Line chart of daily phone hours against a goal line.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how long you spend on your phone each day compared to your goal, so the habit does not creep up on you.
